findings.title: RBAC matrix is enforced per-route but not documented as a single ARtifact
findings.note: requireAdmin centralised (ARCH-P3-005 fixed); no generated matrix/negative tests per role.
evidence: route-registry.ts enumerates routers without an authz annotation
findings.impact: Role drift is hard to review when routes change.
findings.recommendation: Add an authz annotation to the route registry and a contract test asserting middleware per route.

report:
Built the role/resource matrix from
`apps/api/src/middleware/require-admin.ts`, `authenticate.ts`, the module
routers and the RLS policies. Platform-admin vs workspace-admin are now a
single helper; anonymous Supabase fallbacks are gone.
